Title: Attachment Is the Real Risk
GoalLine: Once something is yours — honest feedback on it starts to feel personal.

Title: Iteration
GoalLine: Recognize whether a second version was shaped by what the first revealed.

Title: Sketching / Quick Visualization
GoalLine: When an idea only exists in your words — pushing back on it means pushing back on you.

Title: Defining Success
GoalLine: You shipped on time — the demo went well — and nobody can agree on whether it worked.

Title: What Usability Testing Is
GoalLine: Learning what works vs. collecting what people think should work — not the same thing.

Title: Prototype Fidelity
GoalLine: When the prototype looks finished — people stop questioning whether the direction is right.

Title: AI as Execution Partner
GoalLine: The output looked complete — everyone moved on — and nobody asked if it was right.

Title: Why You Don't Help During Testing
GoalLine: The participant is going in circles and you know exactly what to tell them. You can't.

Title: Task Statement Design
GoalLine: You wrote it to be clear. What you wrote was a hint.

Title: Observation Effect
GoalLine: Someone behaves differently when they know they're being watched. So do you.

Title: Think-Aloud Protocol
GoalLine: You ask someone to think aloud and they go quiet at exactly the wrong moment.

Title: What a Prototype Is
GoalLine: You've spent a week on it and the first question back is whether this is even the right approach.

Title: Prototype vs MVP
GoalLine: Nobody plans to keep the prototype forever. It just happens.

Title: No UI as Design Goal
GoalLine: The first AI design conversation is about where the panel goes. Nobody's asked whether it needs one.

Title: Moderated Usability Session
GoalLine: Run a session so you learn where people get stuck — without your help.

Title: Unmoderated Usability Testing
GoalLine: Find out where people get stuck without watching them in real time.

Title: AI for Design Work
GoalLine: AI generates fast. Knowing whether to use what it generated takes something else entirely.

Title: Paper Sketch Prototype
GoalLine: The room tells you how to refine what you showed. It doesn't tell you whether to build it at all.

Title: Lo-fi Wireframe Prototype
GoalLine: Visual design guides users through a broken structure. A wireframe tests it before design can cover for it.

Title: AI-Generated Prototype
GoalLine: It generated fast. Nobody stopped to ask whether it was generating the right thing.

Title: Wizard of Oz Prototype
GoalLine: Nobody's sure yet whether users will actually trust the AI feature. Now you can find out.

Title: Conversational Prototype
GoalLine: Script and simulate a conversational flow before writing any code.

Title: High Fidelity Prototype
GoalLine: A hi-fi prototype doesn't just look more finished. It changes what feedback you get — and what you miss.

Title: Service Prototype
GoalLine: Every step worked. The journey failed anyway.

Title: Parallel Prototyping
GoalLine: You asked "does this work?" The question you needed was "which approach works better?"

Title: Build to Think
GoalLine: Wireframes show what you intend. Running code shows what's true.
